editorial.thesis: A trading-and-banking city of about 683,000. Its retail is heavy on apparel, footwear & jewellery and grocery & daily needs, and thin on pharmacy & health retail and fitness & wellness — and 43% of residents live in zones with under 60% of the city's average retail depth.
takeaways: Branded retail is about 28% of Bhubaneswar's. 7.17 chain outlets per lakh residents against 25.41 in Bhubaneswar; 17 of the 51 national brands we track are present, led by Apollo Pharmacy 9, Domino's 5, Reliance Trends 5.

The mapped economy leans to grocery & daily needs. Shares of all mapped places: grocery & daily needs 1.9% (Bhubaneswar 1.3%); shops & retail 18.7% (Bhubaneswar 13.1%); offices 5.8% (Bhubaneswar 11.0%); hotels & stays 4.0% (Bhubaneswar 7.5%). Raw counts would mislead because Bhubaneswar is mapped more completely (15,225 places against 2,001), so we compare mix, not counts.

Supply and demand are misaligned. 8 zones hold 43% of residents with under 60% of the city's average retail depth. Fertilizer Township alone has about 50,000 residents and 1 mapped food & drink places.

Retail is more concentrated than in Bhubaneswar. 53% of commercial places sit in the busiest tenth of the city (Bhubaneswar 47%). The largest cores are Bisra Road · Daily (321 places) and Katchery Road · Basanti Colony (275).

The widest brand gaps against Bhubaneswar. Apollo Pharmacy 9 outlets vs 77; MedPlus 1 outlets vs 37; Reliance Trends 5 outlets vs 34. These are leads to check against live listings, not verdicts: a brand may trade under another name or have opened since the map was updated.

numbers.title: The city in eight numbers
numbers.deck: A 6 km circle around the centre, processed with the same rules as Bhubaneswar, so every comparison is like for like. Where raw counts would mislead — because a bigger city is mapped more completely — we compare shares and mix instead.

map.title: Where people live, where shops are
map.deck: Switch layers. The amber “gap” layer is the one to study: it marks places with many residents but little retail around them. Hover any hexagon (about 0.1 km²) for its numbers; click a zone on the right to isolate it.

captions.residents: Where people live. Katchery Road · Basanti Colony and Bisra Road · Daily are the largest zones by residents (73,000 and 69,000). Modelled residents per square kilometre.
captions.supply: Where the shops are. The busiest tenth of cells hold 53% of all commercial places, and Bisra Road · Daily alone lists 321.
captions.chains: Where the brands are. Bisra Road · Daily holds 17 of the 49 tracked chain outlets, and Katchery Road · Basanti Colony adds 12.
captions.education: Where the campuses are. Katchery Road · Basanti Colony and Koel Nagar · Nac Market lead on education places (28 and 27, with 9 and 14 coaching centres) — a daytime youth market that residents alone do not show.
captions.gap: The gap. Amber: many residents nearby, little retail. Blue: far more retail than local residents explain — the commercial cores that draw people in. The deepest amber sits in Fertilizer Township and Vip Market. The blue cores include Bisra Road · Daily.

zones.title: Zone by zone, by PIN code
zones.deck: Each zone is a postal-code area. Residents are modelled counts; places are mapped businesses and services. “Retail depth” is places per 10,000 residents — the tick marks the city average. Click a row to see it on the map.

mix.title: What the retail layer is made of
mix.deck: Raw counts per resident would favour whichever city is mapped more completely (15,225 places in Bhubaneswar against 2,001 here). So this compares each category's share of all mapped places. 100 means the same share as Bhubaneswar; below 100 is thinner, above is stronger.
mix.note: Against Bhubaneswar, Rourkela's mapped places over-index on grocery & daily needs (1.9% vs 1.3%), shops & retail (18.7% vs 13.1%), banks & finance (9.9% vs 7.6%) and under-index on offices (5.8% vs 11.0%), hotels & stays (4.0% vs 7.5%), services & crafts (4.8% vs 8.6%).

chains.title: Who is mapped here, and who is not
chains.deck: 49 outlets of 17 tracked national brands within 6 km — 7.17 per lakh residents against Bhubaneswar's 25.41 (360 outlets of 35 brands). Filled names have at least one mapped outlet (count shown); dashed names have none.
chains.note: Read dashed names as leads, not verdicts. “No mapped outlet” can mean a brand trades under a different listed name, or has opened since the map was updated. The widest gaps against Bhubaneswar are Apollo Pharmacy (9 vs 77); MedPlus (1 vs 37); Reliance Trends (5 vs 34). Premium reports check every lead against live listings.

formats.title: Which formats have room
formats.deck: 9 formats, thinnest first. The index is the format's share of all mapped places relative to Bhubaneswar's, so low means thin by Bhubaneswar's standard. “Where to look” ranks zones with at least 40,000 residents by residents per mapped outlet — a first-pass screen for where one more outlet would face the least local competition.

people.title: Who the customers are
people.deck: Age mix inside the 6 km circle, from Meta's age rasters (modelled, not a census).
people.note: Rourkela's age mix against Bhubaneswar: children (0–14) 25.4% vs 21.3%, 15–24 19.2% vs 19.4%, working age 47.6% vs 50.2%, 60+ 7.9% vs 9.1%. Under-25s are 45% of residents.

restaurants.read: Restaurants & fast food are 5.5% of mapped places against 5.7% in Bhubaneswar, so the mix is level. Mapped chain outlets: Domino's 5 (Bhubaneswar 22), KFC 3 (Bhubaneswar 10), Wow! Momo 2 (Bhubaneswar 14). No mapped outlet in either city: McDonald's, Faasos.
restaurants.watch: Independent eateries are numerous and unevenly mapped. Treat the index as a screen and confirm competitor density street by street.

cafes.read: Cafés, tea & coffee are 1.9% of mapped places against 2.1% in Bhubaneswar — below its share. Mapped chain outlets: Café Coffee Day 3 (Bhubaneswar 25). No mapped outlet in either city: Chaayos, Chai Sutta Bar, Chai Point, Blue Tokai.
cafes.watch: Chai stalls and independent cafés are under-mapped. A café concept here competes on price and habit as much as on novelty.

desserts.read: Desserts, sweets & ice cream are 0.6% of mapped places against 0.7% in Bhubaneswar — below its share. Mapped chain outlets: Baskin Robbins 4 (Bhubaneswar 9). No mapped outlet in either city: Havmor, Naturals, Theobroma.
desserts.watch: Traditional sweet shops are the real benchmark and sit outside most chain lists.

grocery.read: Grocery & daily needs are 1.9% of mapped places against 1.3% in Bhubaneswar — above its share. Mapped chain outlets: Reliance Smart / Fresh 1 (Bhubaneswar 27), Vishal Mega Mart 1 (Bhubaneswar 4). No mapped outlet in either city: More, Easyday, Star Bazaar.
grocery.watch: Neighbourhood kirana stores are the real incumbents and the least completely mapped outlets, so any gap is overstated. Test a site against local store density before acting.

pharmacy.read: Pharmacy & health retail are 0.9% of mapped places against 1.4% in Bhubaneswar — below its share. Mapped chain outlets: Apollo Pharmacy 9 (Bhubaneswar 77), MedPlus 1 (Bhubaneswar 37). No mapped outlet in either city: Wellness Forever, Frank Ross.
pharmacy.watch: Independent chemists are dense and lightly mapped. Hospital and clinic clusters are the natural anchors.

apparel.read: Apparel, footwear & jewellery are 7.5% of mapped places against 3.8% in Bhubaneswar — above its share. Mapped chain outlets: Reliance Trends 5 (Bhubaneswar 34), Bata 3 (Bhubaneswar 10), Tanishq 3 (Bhubaneswar 7), Raymond 2 (Bhubaneswar 7).
apparel.watch: Established multi-brand traders and local bazaars sit behind these numbers; new entrants compete with them as well as with chains.

banking.read: Banks & ATMs are 9.9% of mapped places against 7.5% in Bhubaneswar — above its share.
banking.watch: This category includes insurance and agency offices, so it overstates branch banking. Use it as a signal of commercial activity, not a branch count.

coaching.read: Coaching & training are 3.1% of mapped places against 3.6% in Bhubaneswar — below its share.
coaching.watch: Coaching demand follows the exam calendar. Formats that depend on it should be tested across the academic year.

fitness.read: Fitness & wellness are 3.9% of mapped places against 4.7% in Bhubaneswar — below its share.
fitness.watch: Gym listings change often and are inconsistently categorised; verify before drawing conclusions.
